note: Full 640x480 pixel input is 921600 floats; the forage partial-view A64/MB256 recipe does not fit 8GB. Pixel allocation chosen from measured SPS probes.
coin_semantics: Arrival branch consumes entities on both rows (consume-once). All pre-fix results in results.md are historical pump-metric artifacts; fixed-code results are in the fixed-code section.

rates.selection: Matched-rate state grid on the fixed game (84M, seed 7, holdout 2027/9001): h20c40 0.543 mean, h10c40 0.628, h5c40 0.755, h3c40 0.773, h2c40 0.796, h1c40 0.830, h0c40 0.877 (ceiling; no hazards in play). h1c40 is the closest-to-target rate that keeps hazards in play (~4 per episode); the ~90% state target is approached (0.82/0.84) but not reached under the corrected coin semantics.

state.budget: INI default 16777216, then 83886080 (forage state-controls reference), then 280000000, each <= 5 min wall clock
state.note: state scaling decided from holdout 2027/9001 trajectory; every run_id preserved; single seed 7, serial
state.canonical_fixed: ld-state-h1c40-84M-s7 (84M at h1c40), repeat ld-state-h1c40-84M-s7-repeat byte-identical 80/80; holdout 0.823194/0.836414; eval double-run identical

pixel.recipe: A4/H64/MB64, H128-L1 core, Nature CNN (SPRITE_CNN_RESEARCH encoder)
pixel.oom_rationale: Full-res 921600-float obs: A8/H64/MB64 ~8.4GB > 7.4GB free (probe OOM); A4/H64/MB64 ~6.4GB fits (measured 470.5 SPS). A8/H32/MB64 also fits (504.9 SPS) but H32 breaks horizon parity with the state recipe; A4 kept for H64 parity.
pixel.budget: timeout 300 wall clock on the INI default total_timesteps=16777216 (LR anneals over 16.7M, not over the truncated allocation), checkpoint interval 55 epochs (256 decisions/epoch), nearest-300s timestamp-only checkpoint selection, no score peeking

eval.flags: headless eval_agents=1 horizon=1 minibatch=1 seed=7 metric=perf; rates matched to the training run (fixed-code runs use the INI h1c40 defaults)
